content: Consider a communication game in which the goal is for a user to communicate a target sequence $x= (x_1, ..., x_m)$ to a system by passing a sequence of keywords $z= (z_1, ..., z_n)$. The user generates keywords $z$ using an encoding strategy $q_{\alpha }(z\mid x)$, and the system attempts to guess the target sequence $x$ via a decoding strategy $p_{\beta }(x\mid z)$.
